about: Shared test vectors for nemo-console-core::check (ADR-0022). The same inputs run natively (crates/nemo-console-core/tests/vectors.rs) and through the WebAssembly build in Node (frontend/tests/cfg-wasm.test.mjs); both must produce `expect` exactly. `build` concatenates [text, repeat] pairs. Regenerate the expectations natively with NEMO_CORE_UPDATE_VECTORS=1 cargo test -p nemo-console-core --test vectors, then review the diff.

cases.text:
# AIPerf load presets (mock copy of clients/aiperf/profiles.yaml)
# Schema: profiles.<name> -> model, endpoint_type (chat|completions), streaming, concurrency 1..64,
# requests 1..2000, isl 1..32768, osl 1..4096, warmup_requests, timeout_s, seed.
version: 1
profiles:
  chat-short:
    description: 200 short chats at concurrency 8 - the everyday load
    model: qwen3.8-flash-next
    endpoint_type: chat
    streaming: true
    concurrency: 8        # requests kept in flight
    requests: 200
    isl: 256
    osl: 128
    warmup_requests: 2
  chat-long:
    description: long prompts, 60 requests at concurrency 4
    model: qwen3.8-flash-next
    endpoint_type: chat
    streaming: true
    concurrency: 4
    requests: 60
    isl: 8192
    osl: 256
    timeout_s: 300
  lightning-burst:
    description: a burst of 400 small requests at concurrency 16 on Lightning
    model: nemotron-lightning
    endpoint_type: chat
    streaming: true
    concurrency: 16
    requests: 400
    isl: 512
    osl: 64

cases.name: evaluator/base
cases.text:
# NeMo Evaluator suites (mock copy of clients/nemo-evaluator/suites.yaml)
# Every suite names a router model and 1-8 benchmarks; max_problems is required (a bounded, shuffled sample).
version: 1
suites:
  smoke:
    description: 50 GSM8K problems - proves the whole path in seconds
    model: qwen3.8-flash-next
    benchmarks:
      - bench: gsm8k
        max_problems: 50
        max_tokens: 1024
  quick:
    description: GSM8K + MMLU, 200 each
    model: qwen3.8-flash-next
    benchmarks:
      - bench: gsm8k
        max_problems: 200
      - bench: mmlu
        max_problems: 200
  full:
    description: three benchmarks at 500 problems, twice each
    model: qwen3.8-flash-next
    benchmarks:
      - bench: gsm8k
        max_problems: 500
        repeats: 2
      - bench: mmlu
        max_problems: 500
      - bench: mmlu_pro
        max_problems: 500
        temperature: 0.0

cases.text:
# NeMo Switchyard routes (mock copy, trimmed from inference/switchyard/routes.toml)
schema_version = 1

[llm_clients.litellm]
format = "openai_chat"
base_url = "http://litellm:4000/v1"
forward_auth = true
max_retries = 2

[targets.lightning]
id = "nemotron-lightning"
llm_client = "litellm"

[targets.qwen-27b-1m]
id = "qwen3.8-27b-1m"
llm_client = "litellm"

[targets.flash-next]
id = "qwen3.8-flash-next"
llm_client = "litellm"

# auto-local's capable tier is the default engine (since 2026-09-26). Own client on purpose: target identity is
# (model id, llm_client), so a second target on the same id and client would be dropped.
[llm_clients.litellm_auto]
format = "openai_chat"
base_url = "http://litellm:4000/v1"
forward_auth = true
max_retries = 2

[targets.flash-next-auto]
id = "qwen3.8-flash-next"
llm_client = "litellm_auto"

# PRIMARY. Fully local.
[routes.auto-local]
id = "auto-local"
type = "stage_router"
capable_target = "flash-next-auto"
efficient_target = "lightning"
picker = "efficient_first"
confidence_threshold = 0.5
recent_turn_window = 3
context_window = 262144

[routes.auto-local.classifier]
target = "lightning"
base_threshold = 0.5
max_output_tokens = 4096

[routes.auto-flashnext]
id = "auto-flashnext"
type = "stage_router"
capable_target = "flash-next"
efficient_target = "lightning"
picker = "efficient_first"
confidence_threshold = 0.5

[routes.direct-lightning]
id = "direct-lightning"
type = "passthrough"
target = "lightning"

[routes.direct-27b]
id = "direct-27b"
type = "passthrough"
target = "qwen-27b-1m"
